notes.title: 100% achievements now possible
notes.content: I removed the broken achievements. This way 100% achievements hunters should be able to get to 100%. Thanks for bringing it to my attention!

notes.title: Race Me Now announcement
notes.content:
Dear Valued Players,
Race Me Now is entering a new chapter. The game will soon be available for free (date TBC). 
Thank you to everyone who supported the game in its first year.
Happy playing!
Konrad, Werys LTD

notes.title: Race Me Now has been released!
notes.content: Race sneaky opponents in beautiful surroundings. Races are fast and ruthless, other drivers will try to push you out of the road to take your place. Will you be able to push them out first? Will you be able to beat them all? Will you become the champion?
